thread:
Maya Patel: Ok team — we need a compact one-pager + webinar outline + benchmark narrative aimed at enterprise buyers (security, SLAs, deploy modes). Field deadline: next Tuesday. Also need inbound lead routing rules that map by security posture and usage. Who can pick up which pieces?

Liam Chen: I can draft the one-pager. Suggest sections: 1) TL;DR value prop, 2) Deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) w/one-line tradeoffs, 3) SLA & security summary, 4) Quick benchmark highlights, 5) CTA / next steps for field. Will post draft by EOD tomorrow. :+1:

Jordan Rivera: I’ll own the benchmark narrative and slide deck for the webinar. Plan: pick 3 real-world workloads (chatbot, search/embeddings, batch summarize), show p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and degrade/resilience story with fallback to cheaper variant. Need sample queries — @Maya can you confirm the dataset to use?

Maya Patel: Jordan — use the customer-sim benchmark set from /docs/benchmarks/ave-2025 (synth + sampled prod prompts). Focus on 8k window for summarize workload.

Sarah Cho: I’ll map inbound routing. Proposal (high level):
- Regulated customers (gov, healthcare, finance) or VPC/private flag -> route to Enterprise SE + Sales rep (priority)
- Estimated monthly usage >= 1M tokens OR expected latency SLA -> route to AE
- Trials & PLG signups -> nurture via Growth and automated kickoff
- Webinar signups tagged "enterprise interest" -> SalesOps queue with priority=medium

Sarah Cho: Quick pseudo-config for SalesOps routing:
```
if lead.regulated == true or lead.private_net == true:
  team = "enterprise_se"
elif lead.estimated_tokens_per_month >= 1_000_000:
  team = "ae"
else:
  team = "growth"
```
Also add region-based fallback: EU-regulated -> EU field team.

Liam Chen: For the one-pager I'll add a small "SLA snapshot" box with recommended targets (suggested copy):
- Availability: 99.9% (Dedicated & Hosted SLA tiers)
- Latency SLOs: p50 30–120ms depending on model size, p95 targets for interactive workloads
- Data controls: VPC, KMS, audit logs
Make the SLA numbers phrased as "typical delivered SLOs — contact sales for contractual SLAs".

Jordan Rivera: Benchmark narrative bullets to include in the one-pager/webinar:
- Typical latency & cost tradeoffs for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
- Example: Chat (gpt-like) — Hosted: p95=120ms cost=$0.XX/1k; Dedicated: p95=80ms cost=$0.YY/1k
- Cache & batching impact: show 2–4x cost reduction for high prefix reuse
- Failover: cross-region routing keeps 95% of requests within SLA during single-region outage

Maya Patel: Good. Also include a short section on rollout/upgrade safety: canary deploys + automatic fallback to pinned model when regression detected. Field likes concrete ops controls.

Sarah Cho: One more inbound detail — add a "screenshot" placeholder for the routing rules in the playbook and a sample email template for AEs to use when following up post-webinar.

Liam Chen: I'll include a 1-paragraph benchmark summary for the hero box and a single-table comparison for deploy modes (latency, cost, data controls, best-fit use case). Keep design ops minimal for quick field printing.

Jordan Rivera: Webinar plan outline (30–40m):
- 5m intro + customer pain
- 10m demo: hosted vs dedicated provisioning + failover demo
- 10m benchmarks & cost walkthrough
- 5m security & compliance deep dive
- 5–10m Q&A + CTA (book a private workshop)
Speakers: Jordan (bench/demo), Sarah (field routing & integration), Maya (product/positioning)

Maya Patel: Great — action items:
- Liam: one-pager draft by EOD tomorrow
- Jordan: benchmark slides + demo checklist by EOD Mon
- Sarah: routing snippet + email templates by EOD Mon
I’ll assemble the marketing assets and push to the webinar page. Tag me when drafts are ready.

Ezra (ops-bot): Upload scheduled: assets/webinar-enterprise-2026/ (auto-create placeholder). Reminder: book webinar Zoom + field inbox routing in Salesforce.

Liam Chen: One question — do we want to call out specific SLA numbers in the one-pager or keep them illustrative? I prefer illustrative to avoid contractual confusion.

Maya Patel: Keep them illustrative. Add a small note: "Contractual SLAs available for Dedicated / Private — contact sales."

Jordan Rivera: Adding a short customer quote section (placeholder): "We moved to Dedicated for predictable throughput and 30% cost savings on high reuse workloads." — will flag as sample until we get approvals.

Sarah Cho: I'll drop sample routing JSON and a SalesOps play in the shared doc. Also: tag webinar registrants from regulated domains with label `enterprise-interested` for auto-followup.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Thanks team — sync-up in tomorrow's 2pm marketing stand for progress check. :rocket:
